sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 80 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Estimated paved driving-road limits from the pinned licensed satellite image, inspected at its approximately 0.41 m ground pixel spacing. The retained source route includes the motorcycle chicane: it is not the Formula 1 straight-through configuration. The operator identifies that chicane as a distinct motorcycle layout. Limits follow visible paint/curb transitions, excluding green shoulders, gravel runoff, fences and access roads. Both limits at station 72 interpolate beneath a bridge between stations 66 and 96 (about 90 m). The station-726 gantry interpolates between stations 720 and 732. The inner limit at the shared pit-entry opening, stations 510–540 (about 90 m), is a virtual join between adjoining observations; the outer limit at the straight/chicane merge around station 1044 also joins adjoining limits. Neither is a surveyed pavement edge through the opening. Other intervals interpolate sparse observations through mapped cross-sections. Original trace, timing and raster terrain remain unchanged. Pixel spacing is not positional accuracy, curbs are illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
